permissions_by_role.description: Assignable permissions vary by base role; educator permissions are the configured cross-role set excluding wildcard grants.

due_on.description: If supplied, must be today or a future date.

question.description: The maximum is configurable with AI_MAX_QUESTION_CHARACTERS. Do not include personal contact information or identity numbers.

lesson_id.description: Requires course_id and an active lesson in that course.

instructions.description: Do not include personal contact information or identity numbers.

scheduled_at.description: A parseable date/time that must be in the future; omitted or null publishes immediately.

UpdateAnnouncementRequest.description: The published or scheduled notice keeps its original audience; audience is not accepted during edits.

due_at.description: Optional parseable date/time; date-only values are supported.

assigned_to.description: Must be an active owner, admin, educator, or teacher in this workspace.

UpdateOrganizationTaskRequest.description: Provide at least one field; all supplied fields are updated without changing omitted values.

UpdateSubscriptionPlanRequest.description: Supply at least one editable field. The Free plan cannot be deactivated.

verification_reference.description: Required when approving a paid or custom-priced plan; not required when rejecting.

entitlements.description: Named plan limits. An empty entitlement set may serialize as an empty array.

AssessmentGradesCsvResponse.description: UTF-8 CSV download with formula-safe text cells.

AssignmentAttachmentFile.description: Private file download; response includes Content-Disposition and nosniff headers.

SandboxPaymentWebhookRequest.description: Sign the exact raw JSON body with X-PaathNexus-Signature, a lowercase hexadecimal HMAC-SHA256 digest. Event IDs are idempotent; reusing an event ID with a different body is rejected.

options.description: Required for objective questions and excluded for short_answer. Single-choice requires exactly one correct option; other objective questions require at least one.

grading_rubric.description: Optional and only valid for short_answer questions. Criterion weights must total 100.

randomized_question_count.description: Cannot exceed the number of selected questions.

closes_at.description: Must be later than opens_at when both are supplied.

selected_option_ids.description: Must contain exactly one option for single-choice questions.

SaveAssessmentAnswerRequest.description: Use selected_option_ids for objective questions or response_text for short-answer questions.

points_awarded.description: Cannot exceed the question points configured in its assessment.

rubric_scores.description: Score every configured criterion exactly once; actual array size is the question rubric size.

ManualAssessmentGradeRequest.description: For questions with a rubric, submit rubric_scores and omit points_awarded. For questions without a rubric, submit points_awarded and omit rubric_scores.

student_id.description: Accepted only for course managers; teacher scope is still enforced.

course_id.description: If supplied, must be an actively enrolled course.

records.description: Include each active roster member exactly once; student_id values must be distinct.

StoreScheduleExceptionRequest.description: Conditional fields depend on type: closure has no class/section/timetable/subject/teacher/timing/room; cancel requires class and may reference a timetable entry; extra requires class, subject, starts_at, and ends_at.

UpdateLiveSessionRequest.description: Recording URLs may be supplied only when completing a live session.

RecordLiveSessionAttendanceRequest.description: Include exactly one entry for every active student in the live-session audience roster.

due_at.description: A date value accepted by Laravel date validation.
